fusions.name: Hind Rake
fusions.desc: You grab the target and rake it with your feet: it deals 12 slashing damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lucky Throw
fusions.desc: Throws your lucky charm, which deals 28 damage and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Quick Paws
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Kept in the Pocket
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
